{{Quote|The assailant was ''clever''... used ''adhesive spray'' from a first aid pack to clog the ''ventilation system'' of our man's armor.|Imperial Officer|<ref name="MSW30" />}}
'''Adhesive spray''' was a component of a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]]. In a pinch it could be used to clog ventilation systems, as [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] did during the [[Mission to Metalorn (Galactic Civil War)|Mission to Metalorn]].<ref name="MSW30" />
